messages:
tara: Heads up — hitting a pattern where gateway -> SQS -> worker loses the parent_id on ~8-12% of traces. trace_id shows up in worker logs but parent is null, so spans aren't stitched. Repro with small payloads seems fine, only happens when requests include larger KV-cache headers.
cheng: Huh. Do we have any logs showing full message attributes? SQS has attribute size limits and we base64 encode the OTEL carrier currently. Might be getting truncated.
rob: I saw similar last week when a customer had huge prompt metadata. The gateway was shoving a full OTEL baggage protobuf into an attribute named `x-otel-ctx`. If it exceeds attribute size it gets silently truncated by the SDK or queue.
devon: Confirmed: SQS message attribute limit = 256KB total per message and 256KB per attribute? I forget exact. But also some AWS SDKs chunk things oddly.
tara: Attached the worker logs: `received msg id=... trace=0f3a... parent= null`. Gateway logs show parent before enqueue. So loss happens at enqueue or by SQS trimming.
cheng: Proposal: normalize a compact carrier for async handoff. Instead of dumping full OTLP-baggage protobuf, we pack a small SpanContextBundle: trace_id, span_id, sampled flag, epoch_ts, optional short parent-tags. Compress (zlib) then base64 and put into `x-rwd-trace-v2`. If attribute would exceed 32KB, write compressed blob to object store and put a pointer `x-rwd-trace-s3` + CRC.
rob: +1 on compressed carrier. Also carry a `v` byte so we can evolve encoding. Make sure the carrier includes a CRC and uncompressed length to detect truncation.
devon: Edge case: multiple hops (gateway -> batcher -> fanout -> worker). We should include a hop_count or ttl in the carrier; increment at each enqueue to avoid infinite loops and to know when to rehydrate from store.
tara: Thoughts on sampling? Right now we propagate `sampled` sometimes, but downstream sampling decisions sometimes override and drop parent linkage.
rob: We must propagate sampling *decision* and `debug` bit. Worker should not resample to 0 if parent says sampled=1; reverse is okay (child can be unsampled) but we want determinism for rollout fidelity. Also include `forced_debug` to allow trace debug sessions.
cheng: Implementation sketch (gateway):
```
# pseudo-python
from zlib import compress
from base64 import b64encode
carrier = {"trace_id": t, "span_id": p, "flags": flags, "ts": now}
blob = compress(serialize_pb(carrier))
attr = b64encode(blob).decode('ascii')
msg.attributes['x-rwd-trace-v2'] = attr
```
Worker: decode, check crc, if missing attribute then check `x-rwd-trace-s3` pointer then fetch and rehydrate.
```
# worker side
if 'x-rwd-trace-v2' in msg.attributes:
  raw = b64decode(msg.attributes['x-rwd-trace-v2'])
  data = decompress(raw)
  sc = parse_pb(data)
else if 'x-rwd-trace-s3' in msg.attributes:
  fetch and validate crc
```
devon: Nice. We should also add a short-lived retention policy for rehydration objects (24h default) and auto-expire to avoid leak costs. Include auditing so we can map object->message id.
otel-bot: note: otel SDKs currently support text_map inject/extract. This v2 will be binary. We'll need small helpers in our redwood-otel shim to convert between OTEL Context and our carrier. Add unit tests for inject/extract roundtrip and a fuzz test for truncation.
rob: Testing: create a canary that enables `trace-handoff-v2` at 5% traffic on gateway; run backlog load that triggers large KV headers for 1hr and verify parent_ids at worker. If good -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days. If we see >0.5% drop, rollback.
sre-oncall: For rollout we need metrics: `trace.handoff.failures` (count), `trace.handoff.rehydration_fetch_latency`, `trace.handoff.crc_mismatch`. Also a dashboard tile for parent_link_ratio (good_parent_spans / total_spans) per service.
tara: Action items: 1) cheng add packer/unpacker helper lib PR + unit tests, 2) devon add S3 pointer store + GC policy, 3) rob prepare canary rollout plan + dashboard, 4) otel team add shim to redwood-otel. I'll own coord and feature flag `trace-handoff-v2`.
rob: One more: ensure we don't exceed message attribute count limits. Better to prefer single `x-rwd-trace-v2` attribute and keep other bookkeeping in body.
devon: I'll add hop_count and ttl enforcement in batchers. Also will log truncated attribute sizes to s3 for debugging.
tara: Cool. If anyone wants to pair on the helper lib I can join for an hour tomorrow. Thanks. :thumbsup:
